messages:
Olivia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands wins/losses: we got a bunch of questions about why we lose to VendorX (latency + pricing). Can leadership summarize recurring asks and next steps?
Ava (CEO): Short list: committed/predictable pricing examples, reproducible latency SLO docs, and smoother Private onboarding + residency/audit language.
Ravi (Product): From post-mortems: customers want numbers (committed discounts, OPEX delta), a one-page migration ROI, and an easy Private runbook.
Priya (Customer Success): Also asking for short demo vids that show Private deploy + audit log access in 10 minutes.
Jordan (Eng): Engineering: some losses are single-digit-ms p95 for mobile. We can reach those with tuned configs but need reproducible bench artifacts.
Maya (Sales): Procurement keeps pushing for standard contract clauses around residency & logs. That blocks regulated buyers.
Claire (Strategy): Suggest owners + priorities so we can act.
Ava (CEO): Owners: Product -> pricing + onboarding packet; Eng -> SLO cookbook & bench runs; CS -> validation with lost accounts; Sales -> procurement templates. Small bench budget approved.
Ravi (Product): I'll draft the one-pagers and ROI table. ETA: next Wed.
Jordan (Eng): I'll assemble a short SLO cookbook (seq 32/128/512; GPU/CPU baselines) and run regional benches. ETA: 10 business days. Example snippet to include:
```
model: redwood-lowlat-v1
batch_size: 4
seq_len: 128
p95_latency: 22ms
```
Priya (Customer Success): CS will test artifacts with 5 closed-lost accounts and record 2 walkthrough videos.
Maya (Sales): I'll prepare a one-slide-per-ask template and draft procurement FAQ for Legal.
ops-bot: bench-run queued: est. 10 GPU-hours across 2 regions; provisional cost ~$1k. Full quote in #eng-infra.
Olivia: Please add a tracker in the all-hands follow-up doc with owners & ETA. Claire, can you compile?
Claire (Strategy): Will compile & circulate by EOD. Priorities: 1) SLO cookbook, 2) pricing/ROI, 3) Private onboarding, 4) procurement templates.
Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone. Let's convert these into sales-ready artifacts and close some deals.
